title: Technetium [Forge]
description: The forge version of the Technetium modpack
body:
The forge version of [Technetium](https://modrinth.com/modpack/botmodpack).

#### Pros: 
  - A base for adding more forge mods
  - Create: Enchantment Industry
  - Create: Molten Vents
  - Create: Northstar
  - Create: The Factory Must Grow
  - Crossroads
  - GregtechCEu Modern
  - LittleTiles
  - ProjectRed (Core, Illumination, Integration, Transmission)
  - Robotics
  - Sinytra Connector
  - The Aether

#### Cons:
  - A lot fewer mods

Credits:
  - [ProjectRed](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/project-red-core)
